transformations.edit: Extracted the target-local Chunks representation with private `v` and `chunk_size` fields, preserving field names, order, types, and privacy while omitting Rust stability/doc attributes.
Included Chunks::new with the real Rust body `Self { v: slice, chunk_size: size }` so the target call is verified rather than trusted.
Adapted the inherent `[T]` receiver to an explicit `slice: &[T]` parameter and named return for Verus; the executable body remains assert then Chunks::new(slice, chunk_size).
Converted Rust `assert!(chunk_size != 0, ...)` to Verus `assert(chunk_size != 0)` under the same generated precondition; no control-flow path is removed.
Defined the closed iterator-view helper from the extracted `v` and `chunk_size` fields to expose source, remaining, empty yielded prefix/remainder, requested chunk size, and forward direction.
Revealed the closed iterator-view definition in ghost proof blocks; this has no executable data-flow or evaluation-order effect.
